subject: math
title: Pattern Detective
concept: Odd number patterns in the multiplication table hide a culprit's alibi; explain the pattern to close the case.

new_concept: Color the multiplication table to make patterns pop (every even product, every multiple of 5, the square numbers), predict the next colored square and explain the rule in one sentence, then use a pattern to crack a two-step word problem.

subject: health-pe
title: Boundaries Builder

subject: math
title: Pizza Physics
concept: Is one 16-inch pizza more than two 10-inch ones? Measure and compare circles to settle classic food debates.
pass_concept: Settle classic round-object arguments (one big trampoline or two small ones? a 26-inch bike wheel or a 20-inch?) by measuring circumference and area.
new_concept: Settle classic round-object arguments (one big trampoline or two small ones? a 26-inch bike wheel or a 20-inch?) by measuring circumference and area.

subject: cte
title: Compound Interest Garden
concept: Plant savings and watch them grow with compound interest over decades.
pass_concept: Live a year of surprise costs (a flat tire, a cracked phone, a vet bill) with and without an emergency fund, then see what the fund grows to if it sits untouched for ten years.
new_concept: Two savers put in the same $50 a month, one from age 16 and one from 26; a stacked bar splits each year into deposits, interest and interest on interest. Change the rate or how often it compounds, then find the rule of 72. A plain savings account at a fixed rate, so no market returns (market-time-machine) and no doubling-penny sequences (savings-plan).
rules: Title: Rainy Day Fund becomes Compound Interest Head Start, so the topic word stays in the title.
Topic line under the title on the tool page: "saving and compound interest".
Family: Stays in money, and compound interest is back at the core (the pass had moved it to emergency funds).
why: Grows savings over decades like the live savings-plan and market-time-machine.

subject: math
title: Design the Study
concept: Plan a study on energy drinks; every design choice gets reviewed by a skeptical journal editor.
pass_concept: Test whether energy drinks really speed up reaction times: choose random assignment, a control group, blinding and a placebo, and a skeptical journal editor shows how each missing piece lets a hidden variable fake the result. Surveys and sampling stay with poll-workshop.
new_concept: Test whether energy drinks really speed up reaction times: choose random assignment, a control group, blinding and a placebo, and a skeptical journal editor shows how each missing piece lets a hidden variable fake the result. Surveys and sampling stay with poll-workshop.
why: Shares S-IC.B and the newsroom setting with the live poll-workshop, which already covers sampling, wording and bias.

subject: social-studies
title: Local Changemaker Planner
concept: Plan a real civic action project: find the decision-maker, gather evidence and draft a proposal.
pass_concept: Pick a local problem (a dangerous crosswalk, a closed library branch) and trace who actually decides it: which office, which meeting, when public comment opens; then draft the testimony or petition that reaches them.
new_concept: Pick a local problem (a dangerous crosswalk, a closed library branch) and trace who actually decides it: which office, which meeting, when public comment opens; then draft the testimony or petition that reaches them.

subject: science
cluster_title: A city to run beside a live city tycoon

subject: science

new_concept: Design a zipline from a cliff platform to a far tree; with friction on, energy conservation decides whether the rider reaches the far platform and how hard the brake has to work.

subject: math
